The University of Utah Division of Games is hiring!

The Division of Games at the University of Utah is searching for a new colleague who works in the area of Teams in Game Development, Game Play, and/or Esports to join us in July 2027. This position is part of PRESS PLAY, the U’s $25M, multi-year investment in the faculty, facilities, and programs of the Division of Games.  Here are some details:

Associate/Full Professor in Teams in Game Development, Game Play, and/or Esports

We’re looking for a scholar who studies how teams, groups, and organizations create, coordinate, and innovate in game development, gameplay, and virtual worlds. Relevant areas include team cognition and collaborative design, HCI for game-making teams, production processes, team dynamics and performance in esports, computational modeling of teams, human-AI teaming, and socio-technical systems. You’ll lead an externally funded research program and help grow our graduate and cross-disciplinary research enterprise.

<

>

This role connects to partners across campus, including the Kahlert School of Computing, the Eccles School of Business, Psychology, the University’s varsity esports organization, and the planned Institute for Digital Experience.

If you have questions about this position, please reach out to me or any of the faculty in the Division directly. And if you know someone who’d be a great fit, please share this with them!
